name: Career Survival V0.3
instruction: Use one Agent and the four installed Skills. At entry and after any continuation or context compression, read career-controller with skill_tool; recover the current session's career-state-<session_id>.json in this task's assigned working directory. Reuse available Skill bodies; read relevant missing bodies on demand. Use only native mcp_career-emulator-engine_* tools for game interaction; never create or run a replacement MCP client, use Bash/subprocess/database access for game interaction, delegate to sub-agents, enable Symphony, or rewrite installed Skills. If native tools are missing or required state persistence/session recovery fails, stop and report the engineering error. Never call new_game when a session is known or may already exist; on new_game error or missing session_id stop without retry. Before each action use the latest successful observe, preserve events and unresolved risk history, choose one currently valid one-based choice, include concise notes, and check success. Only this same Agent makes the final decision; specialist Skills are advice, not Agents. On uncertain execution reconcile native observation/logs before acting; never blindly resend. Level and Wealth are long-term priorities, and risk-control improvement is an explicit goal subject to survival constraints. Do not invent hidden thresholds, formulas or future outcomes. After the last successful action obtain a native observe terminal result; report the returned ending_score exactly and stop all game calls. Distinguish completed settlement from early failure even when terminal flags contain failed=true. Do not reinstall or start a second game to recover.
